notes.title: Fiend Heart 1.1 is now live
notes.notes:
Small update which adds small features to the game, here is a list of the changes:

[list]
[*]Keyboard and Gamepad rebind features added.
[*]The aerial movement for the jump of Eliza have changed, player now have more control in air.
[*]Back flip have invincible frames, is more useful than before for dodging saw and fireballs .
[*]Eliza have a new visual effect when air dashing, wall jumping and sliding.
[/list]

 If you find any bug please let me know. Thanks for the patience,

notes.title: The upcoming weekend a small update is coming!!!
notes.notes:
Originally I was planning on making a big update with new levels for January, but so many circumstances didn't allow me to fully dedicated to the project, so I have decided to make smaller updates and keep developing Fiend Heart in the long run along side my other projects. 

The update coming this week will add the ability to rebind controls key and add more control to the aerial movement of Eliza. When I upload the new build I will post the full list of changes in detail.

Thank you for reading.
-RM120

notes.title: One year ago, I released Fiend Heart
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168939/dfb31e16fa3bc1363ec46497e8693662d3503c22.png[/img]
Hello, I am RM120, and I developed this game alone (which is also my first game ever) on my free time after work. Prior to this game I hadn't any experience on coding, neither on sprite animation and neither on composing music. So, the making of this game was a learning experience, and I had fun on all the process from beginning to end, because the game is made with stuff I personally like: monster girls, castles and music with harpsichord.

My goal with Fiend Heart was a making a game with things I like just for the fun and learn in the process. 

In the last year, I keep studying by myself coding and I am better at that now, so there is small update coming to Fiend Heart for January, in which I will add some new features, like the ability to rebind keys of the keyboard and controller, which is a feature some people asked.

Another change I gonna make are on the gameplay, for example, Eliza change immediately the direction in a mid air jump without losing speed, this was intentional gameplay design from my part, the idea was that the players use the fixed distance the air dash travel to put themselves on the right place, but the impression I have is that people don't liked that, so I have plans on changing that gameplay aspect.

About the difficulty of this game, Fiend Heart it's supposed to be challenging like an old school game at which the player can improve the more he plays it. In fact, is possibly to beat the game without taking damage as I do it myself on this video from 10 months ago:

[previewyoutube=JNcEDgMayjM;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, I read the reviews and the feedback I received here and on other places, so I gonna make some changes on the levels without dropping the difficulty, but mostly making more clear where the obstacles are on the screen. 

In other news, I'm working in a new game for the next year, I will have more info about that later but if you wish to see my progress you can check my [url=https://twitter.com/RM120_]Twitter[/url].

For conclusion, Fiend Heart is not dead project, in fact, I have plans on making a remake in the future, but for now, this version will be a prototype. I as a developer, I have a long term goal of making games with my characters and expand the universe on which they exist.  In other words, I wanna keep making games because it's fun.... but also I want YOU to have fun, because that is the point of a game in my opinion, so If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions, feel free to say it here on Steam, on my [url=https://twitter.com/RM120_]Twitter[/url] or in my [url=https://discord.com/invite/WNNPCsc2dv]Discord[/url], I will be checking them every day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168939/d11a36e2e8d5e23a214b26f5b173b0d44702ff3f.png[/img]
Thank you for reading.
-RM120
